PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_BASIC_RELIC.title: Penance Badge
PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_BASIC_RELIC.descripti:
At the start of combat, gain [gold]Barrier[/gold] equal to [blue]10%[/blue] of your Max HP and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Judgment[/gold], and gain all stored [gold]Barrier[/gold].
Healing from Potions and Resting is converted into an equal amount of [gold]Barrier[/gold] (stored out of combat).
At the end of combat, convert [blue]10%[/blue] of your remaining [gold]Barrier[/gold] into HP healing.
PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_BASIC_RELIC.flavor: March forward upon the thorns, carving a path where none existed before.
PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_BASIC_RELIC.short_des: At the start of combat, gain Barrier, Judgment, and Stored Barrier. Non-combat healing is converted into Stored Barrier. At the end of combat, heal based on your remaining Barrier percentage. (Enter the game to view more.)
PENANCEMOD-BLACK_UMBRELLA.title: Black Umbrella
PENANCEMOD-BLACK_UMBRELLA.description: Once per combat, when your [gold]Block[/gold] is broken for the first time, apply [blue]{Umbrella-Vuln}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to the attacker and gain [blue]{Umbrella-Str}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-BLACK_UMBRELLA.flavor: What bad timing, you chose to come to Syracusa now?
PENANCEMOD-BLOODSTAINED_CLOTH.title: Bloodstained Fabric
PENANCEMOD-BLOODSTAINED_CLOTH.descriptio: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{Cloth-Str}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{Cloth-Thorns}[/blue] [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-CARNIVAL_MOMENT.title: Time of Revelry
PENANCEMOD-CARNIVAL_MOMENT.description: All [gold]Wolfpack Curses[/gold] you currently have and obtain in the future are [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-CARNIVAL_MOMENT.flavor: Behold, this is Syracusa—The Lord of Revelry invites you to enjoy the show!
PENANCEMOD-GOLDEN_SCALES.title: Golden Scales
PENANCEMOD-GOLDEN_SCALES.description: At the end of your turn, if you discarded an [gold]Attack[/gold] card this turn, gain [blue]{Scales-Def}[/blue] [gold]Self-Defense[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-GOLDEN_SCALES.flavor: Can crimes be punished through methods outside of the law?
PENANCEMOD-INNOCENT.title: "Innocent"
PENANCEMOD-INNOCENT.flavor: Before dawn, there are two ways to coexist with the night: either let it soak through you until you can no longer feel it; or search the night for everything that shouldn't have been swallowed by it, and cherish it carefully.
PENANCEMOD-LETTER_OF_GRATITUDE.title: Letter of Thanks
PENANCEMOD-LETTER_OF_GRATITUDE.descripti: Whenever you gain [gold]Barrier[/gold], gain an additional [blue]{Gratitude-Pct}%[/blue] (minimum of [blue]{Gratitude-Min}[/blue]).
PENANCEMOD-LETTER_OF_GRATITUDE.flavor: ......But at least everything you did was worth it.
PENANCEMOD-MEDAL_OF_PERSEVERANCE.title: Medal of Perseverance
PENANCEMOD-MEDAL_OF_PERSEVERANCE.descrip: Congratulations, you proved your perseverance by stacking Barrier!
PENANCEMOD-MEDAL_OF_PERSEVERANCE.flavor: Some think this is a design error, others think the numbers are broken. But you, my friend, you proved that as long as you are willing to spend time stacking Barrier, nothing is unkillable. This is your reward, don't despise it, after all, you tortured that poor guy enough. Don't worry, this text overflow is also calculated.
PENANCEMOD-SHOP_VOUCHER.title: Shop Voucher
PENANCEMOD-SHOP_VOUCHER.description: Whenever your [gold]Judgment[/gold] deals damage, deal an additional [blue]{Voucher-Dmg}[/blue] damage.
PENANCEMOD-SHOP_VOUCHER.flavor: If you come here during the rainy season of Syracusa, why not find a small shop by the street and sit for a while.
PENANCEMOD-SIRACUSAN_WINE.title: Syracusan Wine
PENANCEMOD-SIRACUSAN_WINE.description: Each combat, the first time you lose [blue]{Wine-TriggerDmg}[/blue] or more HP, gain [blue]{Wine-MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP and heal [blue]{Wine-Heal}[/blue] HP.
PENANCEMOD-SIRACUSAN_WINE.flavor: Expensive goods from Syracusa. Whether its effect is to relieve fatigue or alleviate pain, the moment you see the price, it all turns into stress.
PENANCEMOD-PLASTIC_MOLE.title: Plastic Mole
PENANCEMOD-PLASTIC_MOLE.description: Whenever enemies intend to attack a total of [blue]{Mole-Threshold}[/blue] times, gain [blue]{Mole-Energy}[/blue] Energy.
PENANCEMOD-PLASTIC_MOLE.flavor: At least in the game, the gavel will land solidly on the heads of these plastic moles.
PENANCEMOD-THORNBOUND_CODEX.title: Thornbound Codex
PENANCEMOD-THORNBOUND_CODEX.description:
Gain [energy] at the start of your turn.
At the end of your turn, shuffle a random [gold]Wolfpack Curse[/gold] into your draw pile.
PENANCEMOD-THORNBOUND_CODEX.flavor: What the law does not specify, I will reveal through practice.
PENANCEMOD-LITTLE_GAVEL.title: Small Gavel
PENANCEMOD-LITTLE_GAVEL.description: Whenever your [gold]Block[/gold] is broken, gain [gold]Barrier[/gold] equal to the damage absorbed by that Block.
PENANCEMOD-LITTLE_GAVEL.flavor: Even the greatest justice must start from somewhere small.
PENANCEMOD-THORNY_ROAD.title: The Thorny Road That Continues
PENANCEMOD-THORNY_ROAD.flavor: It pricks you constantly, reminding you of the weight of justice.
PENANCEMOD-THORNY_ROAD.description:
At the start of combat, gain [gold]Barrier[/gold] equal to [blue]30%[/blue] of your Max HP and [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Judgment[/gold], and gain all stored [gold]Barrier[/gold].
Whenever you kill an enemy in combat, store [gold]Barrier[/gold] equal to [blue]10%[/blue] of your Max HP into the relic.
Healing from [gold]Rest Sites[/gold] and [gold]Potions[/gold] is converted into an equal amount of [gold]Barrier[/gold] (stored into the relic outside of combat).
At the end of combat, convert [blue]10%[/blue] of your remaining [gold]Barrier[/gold] into HP healing.
PENANCEMOD-CHAPTER_OF_PENANCE.title: Chapter of Penance
PENANCEMOD-CHAPTER_OF_PENANCE.flavor: The more you bear, the heavier the judgment.
Your Barrier cap is equal to your Max HP.
At the start of your turn, Barrier decays by 50%.
After Thorn Aura triggers, its stacks are reduced by 50%.
When automatically playing a Wolfpack Curse, lose 1 Energy.
